functions.criteria: Leading a political party or movement and setting its strategy. Incidental Politburo membership does not override a defining security, military, economic or propaganda career.
Heads of government or state, general public and regional administration. Prefer a specialized function when it defines the career.
Military command, operations and organization. Intelligence and counterintelligence chiefs belong to security.
Intelligence, counterintelligence, policing and security administration. Being persecuted does not qualify.
Diplomats and international organization staff, including Comintern international work. Living abroad alone does not qualify.
Economic planning, finance, banking, trade and policy administration. Academic research alone belongs to scholarship.
Industrial administration, factory and armaments production management. Research and technical design belong to science.
Agricultural administration, land policy and agrarian organizing. Peasant origins alone do not qualify.
Party/state ideological administration, propaganda, censorship and cultural control. Independent creative work belongs to arts.
Labor, peasant, civic or underground political organizing, activism and resistance. Not a catch-all for everyone called a revolutionary or dissident.
Historical, social-scientific, philosophical and theoretical research. Research subjects and citizenship are not political affiliations.
Natural science, engineering, medicine, research, development and technical design. An industry minister is not automatically a scientist.
Literary, visual, musical and performing arts. Administration of censorship belongs to propaganda.
Legal practice, defense counsel, prosecution, judging and judicial administration. Academic legal theory belongs to scholarship; being a defendant or victim alone does not qualify.
